classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the total journey time, convert the fractional hour to minutes and determine the arrival time.

content.prompt: A family are travelling in a car at a steady speed of 85 km/h, and have covered 320 km since they left home at 8 a.m. They plan to have lunch at the next town, which is 422 km from home. When, to the nearest minute, will they have lunch?

answer.worked:
Use the total distance from home to the lunch town.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Journey time}&=\frac{422}{85}\text{ h}\\\text{Journey time}&=4\text{ h}+\frac{82}{85}\text{ h}\\\text{Remaining minutes}&=\frac{82}{85}\times60\\\text{Remaining minutes}&=\frac{984}{17}\text{ min}\\\text{Remaining minutes}&\approx58\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

Leaving at 8 a.m. and travelling for 4 hours 58 minutes gives lunch at 12:58 p.m., to the nearest minute.
